I believe scientists have a duty to ensure their work is as reproducible as possible. For contemporary computational sciences, this includes transparency of computational tools and software as well as theory and data! As such, where possible, each of my publications come with links to relevant source code. These are included with the paper listings on my ["Publications"](../research/publications.qmd) page.

Furthermore, I enjoy contributing to open source software intended to further other's scientific practices as well. 
Below I have listed the codebases I have contributed to that are deisgned to be used as packages. Note that code associated to papers that is not designed to be packaged or extensible are not listed here.
